title: Correctness of serial subtraction
statement: For any finite bit string $z$, let $a$ and $b$ be its decoded components, taking a failed decoding to give empty components. Run the $|z|+2$-position serial subtraction procedure on these strings, padded with zeros and initialized with borrow $0$. Its final borrow bit is $1$ exactly when $\operatorname{val}(a)<\operatorname{val}(b)$. If $\operatorname{val}(b)\le\operatorname{val}(a)$, the output has value $\operatorname{val}(a)-\operatorname{val}(b)$.
hypotheses_covered: The procedure uses $|z|+2$ positions and initial borrow $0$
